orientation.fixed_finger_side: TBD after tool-frame mapping; not inferred from photo or firmware tit
orientation.scope: Fixed cube orientation; contact-face choice and complete tool orientation require physical mapping.

runtime.planning_and_calibration: Offline before release; frozen validated joint tables loaded before mode-A operation.
runtime.authority: PL selects, interpolates and executes; PS initializes/logs; PC never streams arm commands.
runtime.startup: Enable only from verified HOME with known empty gripper and occupied/marked slots manually checked.
runtime.inventory: Successful delivery marks that slot unavailable; re-arm alone must not restore presence. Manual restock/check or a validated presence input is required.
runtime.fixture: Flat crosshair/corner tape; no raised slot holder in this geometry. Any holder requires new approach/return validation.

s4_integration.phase_flow: OUT(approach_i,grasp_i,lift_i) -> WAIT_PALM -> DELIVER -> RELEASE -> RETREAT -> HOME
s4_integration.nominal_count_note: 3*(4 approach+1 grasp+5 lift)+1 deliver+1 release+2 unknown retreat placeholders. IK subdivision, holds, HOME preparation and inventory logic may increase this.
s4_integration.common_grip_requirement: Current shared PRE/DELIVER/RELEASE need consistent six-channel entry poses. Validate one common hold angle for all three cubes, or implement per-object delivery tables/retained-gripper semantics; do not change g while carrying just to force equality.
s4_integration.buffer_wait: B may be a passage stop or held pause. Automatic B_WAIT/resume needs PL logic or a proved existing control path; current RUN LIFT does not imply a wait gate at B.
s4_integration.validation_lift: The trial at L_TEST needs manual confirmation during commissioning; autonomous mid-LIFT payload detection/pause is not implemented by this handoff.
s4_integration.release_gate: PALM_READY stability, window and blind expiry follow actual S4 build. Physical support/release condition must be established; no contact sensor is presumed.
s4_integration.warning: Mode-A S4 fixed tables are not the AI-PC mode-B PathPlan submission. S6 max-32 rule is not the whole fixed-table allocation limit.

cancel.known_completed_waypoints: Validate stage retrace including inverse pure gripper segment at P3; return only to task slot.
cancel.mid_segment: S4 retraces to the current segment start after a stop; validate that actual joint-space return sweep under load. Never assume it follows a Cartesian line.
cancel.blind_expiry: With no release, withdraw to PRE and wait again according to the actual S4 implementation.
cancel.after_release: Empty retreat; never retrieve from the user.
cancel.response: Use the build-specific stop/hold/permission fault handling; do not command a blind return or open the gripper.
